title: Tilting a load-aligned slit array: three mechanisms, one minimum
caption: Same porosity, five slit angles. 0°: straight load paths (25.4 N/m). 20°: tips of adjacent rows overlap and link en echelon (8.9 N/m, the minimum). 45°: ligaments rotate before they break (18.5 N/m, modulus collapses). 60° and 90°: the load crosses bridges between slits in bending (7.8 and 4.0 N/m). Screened REBO2, athermal quasi-static uniaxial tension along x; colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV); red rings: atoms that have lost a bond; frames between stored quasi-static states are interpolated. All statements are model results.
slow_motion: 3x within ±0.0025 strain of first damage, peak load and major propagation
text_in_movie: chart axis labels and colour-bar numbers only
colour: energy change per atom relative to the relaxed state (eV), inferno colour map truncated at 0.9
chart: 2D stress (N/m) against engineering strain, one curve per panel in the panel's frame colour, moving marker at the current state
